title: The Estate's Last Will
motive_summary: Elimination of competition for a substantial financial inheritance, disguised as an accident.
overview_text: The body of Isabella Reed was found collapsed on the floor of the Reed & Bell Bookshop. The scene appeared to be a struggle, and the immediate cause of death was apparent by the presence of Brass till weight nearby. The body was discovered by Ben Carter, who immediately called for help.
